harmonisation_notes: Coordinates verified via Ensembl as NCBI35/hg17 (e.g. rs505922 = chr9:133178783). 40/42 assays measured in serum, TSH in EDTA plasma, LPA in citrate plasma (Table S1); FT3/FT4 are thyroid hormones mapped to TG in Table S3a. Targeted 1-2 SNP replication in WATTS, NFBC1966, Health ABC (Table S2).

imputation_panel: Genotyped only (HapMap)
transformation: Log standardized abundance
covariates: None
harmonisation_notes: GRCh36/NCBI36 (dbSNP b130). Main-text Tables I & II report lead rsID, Chr, P, FDR, and r2 without alleles or Beta/SE.

ancestry_detail: Healthy elderly European individuals
platform_version: SomaScan (~800-plex / 813 proteins)

ancestry_detail: European ancestry individuals with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease

ancestry_detail: 41 CEU, 22 YRI, and 9 ASN (8 CHB, 1 JPT) unrelated HapMap LCLs

ancestry_detail: Non-Hispanic Caucasian participants

covariates: Age, sex, education, baseline clinical diagnosis (CN/MCI/AD)
harmonisation_notes: Cis-only scan (+/-500 kb around 137 genes; 1,992 SNPs) across 132 QC-passing RBM analytes (131 proteins + cortisol) in ADNI (N=521); 107 significant hits tested for replication in IMAS (N=59). ancestry_detail: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI)

covariates: None (unrelated YRI LCLs; passage/freeze-thaw mixed model for cellular traits)
harmonisation_notes: Companion paper to Hause et al. 2014 (PMID:25087611) analyzing the exact same 68 YRI LCL 441-antibody (391-protein) dataset on GRCh36/hg18; Stark et al. (published April 2014) reports primary genome-wide pQTLs overlapping cisplatin/paclitaxel cytotoxicity & apoptosis dQTLs (P<1e-4, Table S4).

ancestry_detail: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI)

ancestry_detail: European ancestry (non-Hispanic Caucasian PCA cluster)
platform_version: Myriad RBM Human DiscoveryMAP v1.0 (Luminex 100)

transformation: Log10 / Shapiro-Wilk normal-adjusted CSF analyte levels
covariates: Age, sex, 2 EIGENSOFT ancestry PCs
harmonisation_notes: Sample-size weighted METAL meta-analysis of ADNI (N=308) and Knight ADRC (N=266) across 59 CSF RBM analytes (58 proteins + cortisol). Table S1 reports 335 study-wide significant variants on GRCh37/hg19 (verified via rs2228145=chr1:154426970) with P-values, +/- directions, and MAF (no numeric Beta/SE).

ancestry_detail: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI)
platform_version: SILAC nanoLC-MS/MS (LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro)
imputation_panel: HapMap (210 YRI) + 1000 Genomes (May 2011, BIMBAM)
transformation: Log2(L/H SILAC ratio) standardized per individual and quantile-normalized to N(0,1)
covariates: 9 protein principal components
harmonisation_notes: Cis-pQTL scan (+/-20 kb, MAF>=0.10) across 4,381 SILAC-quantified proteins in 62 HapMap YRI LCLs (online 2014-12-18, print 2015-01-30). Supplementary Data 1 shares 278 FDR<10% cis-pQTLs (ENSG, chr, hg18.pos, perm.p, snp.pvalue, snp.R.value; no rsID, alleles, or SE) and Data 3 shares 68 interaction psQTLs; raw MS in PRIDE PXD001406.

ancestry_detail: Caucasian females of north European descent
platform_version: SWATH-MS (AB Sciex TripleTOF 5600 / OpenSWATH)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 1 (10/11/2010 freeze, IMPUTE v2)
transformation: Rank-normal transformation of family mixed-model residuals after regressing 10 protein PCs on log2(top-2 peptide sum)
covariates: 10 protein principal components + twin family random effect (GenABEL)
gwas_software: GenABEL + R (lm, Fisher test, 20,000 permutations, qvalue)
harmonisation_notes: Female-only TwinsUK SWATH-MS cis-pQTL scan (+/-1 kb TSS); Table S4 reports 13 FDR<0.05 cis-pQTLs.

Tables 2-4 & S3-S5 (MOESM1_ESM.pdf) report GRCh37 coordinates, MAF, Beta, and P-value without SE; Table S6 is cited in text only and not hosted on the publisher page.

ancestry_detail: European (Norwegian, Tromsø municipality)

ancestry_detail: Non-Hispanic White current and former smokers
platform_version: Myriad RBM custom 13-panel multiplex immunoassay
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Illumina OmniExpress+Exome in SPIROMICS; HumanOmniExpress in COPDGene)
transformation: Rank-based normal quantile transformation (<LLOQ imputed at 0.5*LLOQ or Tobit censored)
covariates: Age, sex, BMI, study site, smoking status, pack-years, genotype PCs (plus biomarker PC1 in SPIROMICS)
gwas_software: PLINK (v1.9) + R censReg (Tobit) + Stouffer weighted Z
harmonisation_notes: Meta-analysis of SPIROMICS (N=750; 67 EDTA plasma + 21 serum assays) and COPDGene (N=590; 88 BD P100 K2-EDTA plasma assays) across 88 QC-passing biomarkers (from 115 in S1 Table). Tables S3 (P<1e-5) & S4 (527 genome-wide pQTLs across 38 biomarkers) report GRCh37 coordinates, cohort MAF, beta/z-stat, and P-value without SE or allele letters.

ancestry_detail: European (Southern German, KORA F4 discovery; targeted replication in N=338 Arab/Asian QMDiab)
platform_version: SomaScan v3.2 (1.1k-plex)
imputation_panel: Genotyped discovery (Affymetrix Axiom, 509,946 SNPs); 1000G Phase 3 v5 fine-mapping
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation of linear regression residuals
covariates: Age, sex, BMI

Discovery GWAS in KORA F4 (N=997; 509,946 SNPs across 1,124 QC-passing SOMAmers: 1,120 human + 4 viral); targeted replication of 462 tag-SNP pairs in QMDiab (N=338). Supplemental Data 2 (086793-3.xlsx) reports 539 Bonferroni pQTLs on GRCh37 with alleles, MAF, Beta, SE, and P-value; Data 5 (086793-6.xlsx) reports 14,647 P<1e-5 hits; interactive server at http://proteomics.gwas.eu.

ancestry_detail: European (Finnish)

imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 1 (September 2013 release, 10.7M markers)

covariates: Age, sex, BMI, first 10 genetic PCs
harmonisation_notes: Mixed blood matrices across 3 meta-analysed cohorts: FINRISK1997 (up to N=4,608, EDTA plasma, 17 cytokines), YFS (N=2,019, serum, 41 cytokines), and FINRISK2002 (up to N=1,705, heparin plasma, 41 cytokines); combined N up to 8,293. Open genome-wide GRCh37 summary statistics (GCST004420-GCST004460; computationalmedicine.fi) report alleles, Beta, SE, P-value, and heterogeneity (no genome-wide EAF). Published online 2016-12-15; use AJHG DOI supplements (BioStudies mirror mis-indexed).

ancestry_detail: East Asian (Japanese, Western Tokyo)
platform_version: SomaScan v3 (1,128-plex)
imputation_panel: Genotyped only (Illumina BeadChip, 514,227 SNPs)
transformation: Rank-based (Spearman rank correlation on normalized RFU)
covariates: None
harmonisation_notes: Published online 2016-11-26 (Hum Mol Genet Jan 2017 print). Tables S1 (446 genome-wide FDR<0.01 pairs) & S2 (1,001 cis +/-1 Mb FDR<0.01 pairs) report rsID, Chr, Spearman rho, P, and FDR; individual-level SNP and 1,128-protein RFU matrices openly available in NCBI GEO GSE83711.

ancestry_detail: Trans-ethnic meta-analysis (1,552 European Americans and 1,872 African Americans)
platform_version: Metabolon GC-MS + UHPLC-MS/MS serum oligopeptide profiling
imputation_panel: Whole-genome sequencing (7.4x HiSeq 2000 goSNAP, 7,567,083 MAF>5% variants) + whole-exome sequencing (87x VCRome 2.1)
transformation: Natural log transformation (winsorized at 1st and 99th percentiles; <LOD imputed at minimum detected)
covariates: Age, sex, eGFR, first 3 ancestry PCs (plus measurement phase 2010 vs 2014 in African Americans)
gwas_software: R (seqMeta: single-variant + T5 burden + SKAT; meta fixed-effects inverse-variance)
harmonisation_notes: Full text and open supplements (S. Tab. 1-14) verified on GRCh37. Total N=3,424 ARIC participants (1,552 EA + 1,872 AA) had fasting serum oligopeptide profiles and either WGS or WES: N=3,137 (1,458 EA + 1,679 AA) underwent 7.4x WGS for common single-variant GWAS (7,567,083 MAF>5% variants), 4-kb sliding-window, and regulatory SKAT/T5 scans; N=3,180 (1,330 EA + 1,850 AA) underwent 87x WES for coding-gene SKAT/T5 scans. Of 25 QC-passing peptides (from 49 measured), 2 uniquely map to parent human proteins (DSGEGDFXAEGGGVR -> FGA P02671; HWESASLLR -> C3 P01024) and 23 are short dipeptides/N-acetylcarnosine. Table 1 and S. Tab. 3, 5-9, 12-14 report Alleles, MAF, ln-scale Beta, and P-value without SE.

imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 1 v3 (March 2012, SHAPEIT + IMPUTE2; Illumina HumanCoreExome-12 v1.1; 275,297 LD-pruned r2<0.95 tag SNPs with MAF>=5%, INFO>=0.8)
transformation: Log2 transformation of TMT 6-plex protein ratio fold-changes relative to pooled plasma reference
covariates: Age, sex, baseline BMI (plus genomic relatedness matrix in DiOGenes GEMMA validation)
gwas_software: LOCUS (variational Bayesian sparse multivariate regression) + GEMMA
harmonisation_notes: Active 2019 bioRxiv preprint (posted 2019-01-18; later published in 2020 as PMID:32492067 / 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1007882). Multivariate Bayesian sparse QTL mapping (LOCUS) of 133 6-plex isobaric LC-MS/MS plasma proteins across 275,297 LD-pruned tag SNPs (GRCh37) in Ottawa Weight Management Clinic (N=376), discovering 18 MS pQTLs (14 unique proteins, FDR<5% in Online Table S1) and validating 15/18 (all 15 cis) via GEMMA in pan-European DiOGenes (N=400; Online Table S5 reports DiOGenes validation Beta, SE, and P-value without allele letters or EAF; rs141091409 indel at PROCR; searchable locus-pqtl.epfl.ch portal offline).

ancestry_detail: European overweight/obese adults (Ottawa Weight Management Clinic discovery N=394; pan-European DiOGenes validation N=548)
platform_version: SomaScan 1.1k (1,100 Ottawa & 1,129 DiOGenes SOMAmers; 1,096 shared PASS human SOMAmers)
imputation_panel: 1000 Genomes Phase 1 v3 (March 2012, SHAPEIT + IMPUTE2; Illumina HumanCoreExome-12 v1.1; 275,485 LD-pruned r2<0.95 tag SNPs with MAF>=5%, INFO>=0.8)
transformation: Log2 transformation of HybMedNormCal SomaScan RFU values
covariates: Age, sex, baseline BMI (plus genomic relatedness matrix in DiOGenes GEMMA validation)
gwas_software: LOCUS (variational Bayesian sparse multivariate regression) + GEMMA
harmonisation_notes: Active 2019 bioRxiv preprint (posted 2019-01-18; later published in 2020 as PMID:32492067 / 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1007882). Multivariate Bayesian sparse QTL mapping (LOCUS) of 1,096 shared PASS human SomaScan 1.1k SOMAmers (verified directly from open OSF .adat files v8mes & s4v8t; Ottawa EDTA plasma N=394 discovery, DiOGenes plasma N=548 validation) across 275,485 LD-pruned tag SNPs (GRCh37), discovering 118 SomaScan pQTLs (99 proteins, FDR<5% in Online Table S1) and validating 98/118 (78/81 cis, 20/37 trans) via GEMMA in DiOGenes (Online Table S5).

ancestry_detail: European-American cognitively normal older adults (ROSMAP no cognitive impairment at autopsy, median age at death 86.5 yr, N=144)
platform_version: TMT10-plex 2D-LC-MS/MS (50 batches across 24 high-pH RP fractions; dorsolateral prefrontal cortex BA9; 7,901 proteins)
imputation_panel: Whole-genome sequencing (Illumina HiSeq X, BWA-MEM v0.7.8 + GATK v3.4; Synapse syn10901595; 2,599,383 autosomal SNVs with MAF>5%)
transformation: Log2 ratio to global internal standard (GIS) across TMT10-plex batches
covariates: First 10 WGS genetic principal components
harmonisation_notes: Active 2019 bioRxiv preprint (posted 2019-10-24; v2 2019-11-15; later published in 2021 as PMID:33571421 / 10.1016/j.ajhg.2021.01.012). Post-mortem dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (BA9) TMT10-plex 2D-LC-MS/MS brain cis-pQTL scan (±100 kb around UCSC knownGene on GRCh37; 2,599,383 WGS SNVs with MAF>5%) across 7,901 proteins in N=144 cognitively normal (NCI) Caucasian older adults from ROSMAP (paired with BA46 RNA-seq eQTLs across 5,739 shared genes), identifying 28,211 cis-pQTLs across 864 proteins at FDR<0.05. BioRxiv v1/v2 host 0 supplementary files and brainqtl.org is offline; checked 2021 AJHG published supplements (mmc1.pdf Figures S1-S13 & Tables S1-S3; mmc2.pdf), which reflect the expanded N=330 ROSMAP + N=149 Banner BBDP (7,376 proteins) dataset without a protein-level panel spreadsheet (to be superseded in search/2021).

ancestry_detail: Greek isolated European cohorts (HELIC-MANOLIS Cretan mountain discovery N=1,328; HELIC-Pomak replication N=1,605)
platform_version: Olink Proseek Multiplex CVD II + CVD III + Metabolism (3 x 92-plex; 257 QC-passing unique assays / 258 human Swiss-Prot targets)
imputation_panel: Whole-genome sequencing (22.5x Illumina HiSeq X in MANOLIS & 18.4x in Pomak, GATK v3.5; 13,419,876 autosomal SNVs/indels with MAC>=10)
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation of covariate-residualized Olink NPX values
covariates: Age, age^2, sex, plate number, per-sample mean NPX across assays, season of sample collection, genomic kinship matrix
harmonisation_notes: Active 2019 bioRxiv preprint (posted 2019-11-27; later published in 2020 as PMID:33303764 / 10.1038/s41467-020-20079-2). Deep WGS pGWAS and rare-variant SKAT-O burden scan (13,419,876 SNVs/indels, MAC>=10 on GRCh38) across all 257 QC-passing Olink CVD II + CVD III + Metabolism serum assays (258 reviewed human Swiss-Prot targets indexed from verified Supplementary Table 5 [media-6.xlsx], as IL27 comprises IL27 + EBI3; note ST1a also retains 1 cis-pQTL row for META.DDC P20711 marked >40% missingness in ST5) in Greek isolated HELIC-MANOLIS (N=1,328 discovery, 22.5x WGS) with serum replication and meta-analysis in HELIC-Pomak (N=1,605, 18.4x WGS). Verified all 15 supplement files (media-1.pdf + media-2..15.xlsx, ST1-ST14), including 126 single-variant cis signals, 38 trans signals, and 6 study-wide significant rare-variant cis-RV-pQTLs (ACP6, PON3, IL1RL1/ST2, DPP7, CTSO, GRN in ST12).

ancestry_detail: Finnish European (FINRISK 1997 population survey, N=6,890)
platform_version: Bio-Rad Bio-Plex Pro Human Cytokine 21-plex / 27-plex (12 correlated inflammatory biomarkers selected from 66 quantitative traits)
imputation_panel: Finnish SISu v3 WGS reference panel (3,775 high-coverage genomes; Eagle v2.3.5 + Beagle v4.1 on Illumina/Affymetrix arrays lifted to GRCh38; 11,329,225 variants with INFO>=0.8, MAF>=0.002)
transformation: Rank-based inverse normal transformation of covariate-adjusted residuals (with CCA Linear Combination Phenotype projection for follow-up)
covariates: Age, sex, genotyping chip, first 10 genetic PCs, genetic relationship matrix
gwas_software: Hail (v0.1 LMM) + metaCCA + LCP-GWAS + FINEMAP + MetaPhat
harmonisation_notes: Active 2019 bioRxiv preprint (posted 2019-12-06; later published in 2021 as PMID:33110245 / 10.1038/s41431-020-00730-8). Multivariate canonical-correlation GWAS (metaCCA), Linear Combination Phenotype GWAS (LCP-GWAS), and multivariate FINEMAP across 12 highly correlated Bio-Plex inflammatory biomarkers (13 unique Swiss-Prot targets, as IL-12p70 comprises IL12A + IL12B) in FINRISK 1997 EDTA plasma (N=6,890; 11,329,225 SISu v3 imputed variants on GRCh38), identifying 19 credible-set signals across 11 loci (4 undetected by univariate GWAS: F5, ABO, C1orf140, PDGFRB; Table 2 & open 867267_file02.pdf Tables S1-S8 report GRCh38 chr:pos:ref:alt, AF, multivariate P, minimum univariate P, and FINEMAP posterior probabilities without univariate Beta/SE).
